## resolveConfigPaths() function

Resolve relative paths in the configuration against the repository root.

This converts relative paths in settings.publicKeyPath and settings.attestationsPath to absolute paths relative to the repository root.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function resolveConfigPaths(config: Config, repoRoot: string): Config
```
